from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal


class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = Column(String)
    description = Column(String)
    registration_requirements = Column(String)


router = APIRouter()


def fr_3_1_REQ_1(request: dict) -> dict:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Assuming the request contains event_id and updated fields
        event_id = request.get("event_id")
        if not event_id:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Event ID is required.")

        # Fetch the event from the database
        event = db.query(Event).filter(Event.id == event_id).first()
        if not event:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Event not found.")

        # Update event details if provided
        if "title" in request:
            event.title = request["title"]
        if "description" in request:
            event.description = request["description"]
        if "registration_requirements" in request:
            event.registration_requirements = request["registration_requirements"]

        # Commit changes to the database
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(event)

        return {}
    except Exception as e:
        db.rollback()
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(e))
    finally:
        db.close()

from fastapi import APIRouter, Body, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Boolean
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.extensions import Base, SessionLocal

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = Column(String, nullable=False)
    is_logged_in = Column(Boolean, default=False)


class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = Column(String, nullable=False)
    approved = Column(Boolean, default=False)


router = APIRouter()


def fr_3_2_REQ_1(request: dict) -> dict:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        # Check if user is logged in
        user = db.query(User).first()
        if not user or not user.is_logged_in:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="User is not logged in. Please log in.")

        # Simulate event approval and addition to platform
        event = Event(title="Sample Event", approved=True)
        db.add(event)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(event)

        return {}
    finally:
        db.close()

features.test_source:
import json
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app import create_app

client = TestClient(create_app())

def test_anchor_case():
    # User is not logged in, should be prompted to log in
    resp = client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"request": {}})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == {}

def test_logged_in_user_registration():
    # Setup: Approve event first
    client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"action": "approve_event", "event_id": "456"})
    
    # User is logged in and event is approved
    resp = client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"request": {"user_id": "123", "event_id": "456"}})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json() == {}

def test_unauthorized_registration():
    # User attempts to register without logging in
    resp = client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"request": {"user_id": "unauthenticated", "event_id": "456"}})
    assert resp.status_code >= 400

def test_invalid_event_id():
    # User provides invalid event ID
    resp = client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"request": {"user_id": "123", "event_id": "invalid_event"}})
    assert resp.status_code >= 400

def test_duplicate_registration():
    # Setup: Register user for event
    client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"action": "register", "user_id": "123", "event_id": "456"})
    client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"action": "approve_event", "event_id": "456"})
    
    # User tries to register again
    resp = client.post("/controllers/fr_3_2_REQ_1", json={"request": {"user_id": "123", "event_id": "456"}})
    assert resp.status_code >= 400
